sn35.160:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Jīvakambavane || || 2
sn35.160:1.7: Cakkhum aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Rupā aniccāti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Cakkhuviññāṇam aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Cakkhusamphasso aniccoti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitam || pe || tam pi Aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || || 5-8 Sotaṃ || Ghānaṃ ||
sn35.160:1.9: Mano aniccoti yathābhutam okkhāyati || Dhammā aniccāti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || la ||
sn35.160:1.10: Yam pidam mano samphassapaccayā uppajjati sukkhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi Aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || || 10
